title: Async fetch closes without state coverage
summary: Fetch/API work can look complete while users see no loading, error, or empty state.

title: Environment variables read from many places
summary: Duplicate env reads make local-vs-CI behavior and secret defaults drift between handlers.

title: Webhook success without delivery semantics
summary: Webhook handlers need signature/secret proof plus idempotency or retry semantics; a happy-path POST route is not enough.

title: Migration path tested only as code shape
summary: Backfills, imports, and upgrades need an exercised journey such as dry-run, rollback, checkpoint, or before/after verification.
